skill.name: javascript-pro
skill.description: Guides modern JavaScript work for ES6+, async patterns, Node.js APIs, browser compatibility, performance, and testing.
skill.summary: Modern JavaScript guidance for async code, runtime compatibility, and performance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive in SKILL.md line 45. The phrase describes avoiding deeply nested JavaScript callbacks, and no malicious intent or prompt injection was found.

static_findings.snippet: 4. Avoid callback hell with modern patterns

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 45 says to avoid callback hell with modern patterns, which is standard JavaScript refactoring language. It does not request host enumeration, secret access, network activity, or system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: JavaScript teams often need clear guidance on async behavior, runtime targets, and compatibility. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce practical JavaScript solutions.
actual_capabilities: Guides ES6+ syntax choices, modules, classes, and destructuring.
Explains async behavior with promises, async functions, generators, and microtasks.
Supports JavaScript work for both Node.js and browser environments.
Recommends error handling boundaries for asynchronous code.
Suggests testing approaches for async JavaScript with Jest.
Considers performance, bundle size, and polyfill needs.
limitations: It does not provide full TypeScript architecture guidance.
It is not intended for non-JavaScript runtimes.
It does not make broad backend architecture decisions.
Compatibility advice still needs project-specific runtime targets.

use_cases.title: Debug Async Behavior
use_cases.description: Analyze promise timing, race conditions, and event loop behavior in JavaScript code.

use_cases.title: Modernize Legacy JavaScript
use_cases.description: Plan a migration from callback-heavy code to ES6+ modules and async functions.

use_cases.title: Validate Browser Compatibility
use_cases.description: Review browser APIs, bundle size, and polyfill strategy before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic JavaScript
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small function or file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this JavaScript for modern ES6+ style, clear errors, and browser or Node.js compatibility.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Async Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging of promises or async functions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this async JavaScript flow. Find race conditions, missing awaits, and error handling gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Runtime Compatibility
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for mixed browser and Node.js targets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this JavaScript against these runtime targets. Recommend module, polyfill, and API compatibility changes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Complex JavaScript
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this complex JavaScript for performance, predictable async behavior, clean exports, and Jest test coverage.

output_examples.input: Review a Node.js async task that sometimes finishes early.
output_examples.output: The response identifies a missing await, explains the timing issue, and recommends focused Jest tests for the async path.

output_examples.input: Modernize callback-based browser code for current JavaScript.
output_examples.output: The response proposes an async function structure, clearer error boundaries, and compatibility checks for the target browsers.

output_examples.input: Check a feature before shipping it to browsers and Node.js.
output_examples.output: The response lists runtime concerns, likely polyfills, module format choices, and bundle size risks.

best_practices: Provide runtime targets before asking for compatibility advice.
Include the async call path and expected failure behavior.
Ask for tests when changing promise or event loop behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for unrelated languages or runtimes.
Do not ask for broad backend architecture when only JavaScript guidance is needed.
Do not request compatibility conclusions without browser or Node.js version targets.

faq.question: Does this skill support Node.js work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Node.js APIs, module structure, async behavior, and performance concerns.

faq.question: Can it help with browser compatibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews browser APIs, cross-browser concerns, bundle size, and polyfill strategy.

faq.question: Is this a TypeScript skill?
faq.answer: No. It can discuss migration and type safety, but it is focused on JavaScript.

faq.question: Can it debug race conditions?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to analyze promises, async functions, microtasks, and event loop behavior.

faq.question: Does it generate tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest Jest tests for async code and compatibility-sensitive behavior.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
